items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my mother in Mississippi was always at the Reverend Jones‟ church

ctx.x: Well that was father and he was the pastor of that church. Well my mother was the organist in the church and as I said, she was the only one in our family that had any kind of education. We had a piano. All the choir rehearsals were held at our house. She was the choir director, organist and nursemaid for the Reverend [Unintelligible]. She took care of them and the youngest ones had to take care of me. So he was always preaching in that church to the older folks, “Get your young people out of here because there‟s…
